title: Library
summary: The papers and books the author reads, as PDFs in the app.
description: What the book draws on sits next to it: papers and books, each a PDF with a few details, readable on every device.

stories.as: an author who reads papers and books to write about them
stories.want: my papers and books in the same app as the book
stories.soThat: what I read is at hand on every device where I write

requirements.text: The library holds papers and books, each with one PDF file.
The author adds an item to the library by uploading a PDF of at most `library.max-file-size`.
Each item has a title, authors, a year and a kind from `library.kinds`.
When an item is added, its title, authors and year are taken from the PDF's own metadata where the PDF has them.
The author can edit an item's details.
An item's PDF can be read in the app on every platform in `app.platforms`.
An item's PDF is stored in the database and syncs to the book's devices with the rest of the book.
The author can remove an item, and its PDF with it, from the library.

values.description: What a library item can be.
The largest PDF the library takes, so one file always fits a sync message.
